cover.tagline: SELECTABLE POWER. SELECTABLE CCT. FULL CUTOFF.
cover.positioning: A full cutoff wall pack that keeps light on the ground and off the sky. Wattage and colour temperature are set inside the fixture, so one wall pack covers several designs. For custom solutions please contact our sales representative.

quality_line: Heavy-duty die-cast aluminium with a UV-stabilized powder coat, IP65 and wet-location rated.
description: The NightShade Series Full Cutoff Wallpack is designed to eliminate light pollution and maximize energy savings. Internal switches select the wattage (45, 60 or 75W) and colour temperature (3000, 4000 or 5000K) on site, so one fixture covers several designs. Constructed from heavy-duty die-cast aluminium with a UV-stabilized powder coat, it mounts over a recessed junction box, runs on 120-277VAC with 0-10V dimming, and is IP65 and wet-location rated. Photocell and 8W emergency battery backup are available.
